application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a part two storey, part one storey rear extension and front porch to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Heritage Statement, 16_QPG-P.SP, 16_QPG-P.P.00, 16_QPG-P.P.01, 16_QPG-P.P.02, 16_QPG-P.E.01, 16_QPG-P.E.02, 16_QPG-P.E.03 Side Elevation 1, 16_QPG-P.E.03 Side Elevation 2, 16_QPG-P.S.01, 16_QPG-E.SP, 16_QPG-E.FP, 16_QPG-E.E, 16_QPG-E.S.01 - received 30th March 2021.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
